development_access.warmup_policy: Derive and register from the exact FactorSpec and financial reporting lookback before requesting data; keep all research inputs before2024.

final_executor_access: After freeze only; fixed evaluation2024-01-01 through2026-10-23 plus permitted pre-window training history. Earlier evaluation years can enter later fitting windows only after they have occurred and labels matured.

sources.name: US Equity Coarse Universe
sources.role: historical all-market DollarVolume and universe records

sources.name: US Fundamental Data
sources.role: as-reported financial fields and filing metadata
sources.limitations: Provider documentation excludes ADRs/ETFs/OTC; actual field coverage must be measured

availability.rule: Use a value only after its actual availability; report period-end is not publication time
availability.date_only_filing: Conservatively wait through the next exchange-session close after the filing date and any later actual delivery
availability.proxy_dates: Approximately45-day provider dates are proxies, not certification of true publication
availability.asof_join: Only the latest then-known vintage; never backward-fill future reports or restatements
availability.future_filing_rule: A later filing cannot be inserted into earlier test features merely because evaluation runs later

field_whitelist_policy: Every new FactorSpec must declare exact field paths, units, period accessors, timing and null-handling before computation
operator_policy: Each FactorSpec chooses a restricted subset and fixed parameters/ranges; this catalog does not authorize parameter mining
financial_missing: Keep the liquidity universe unchanged; preregister factor sample and candidate/benchmark comparability
data_residency: Market panels and derived row-level values stay inside authorized QuantConnect cloud; no export through logs or files
coverage_audit_scope: Derive warmup from registered FactorSpec; training/development events and availability strictly before2024; final coverage audit belongs to the independent executor.

shared_cache.partition: calendar year and sorted union-SID chunks of at most64
shared_cache.producer: one explicitly designated cloud process; no distributed CAS guarantee
shared_cache.consumer: prefetched cache-only reads; factor receives causal matrices only
shared_cache.failures: intent retained; reconcile explicitly before refresh with a new version
shared_cache.price_availability: LEAN daily end_time modeled assumption; vendor receipt not certified
shared_cache.historical_membership: mask each historical formation by its own universe before cross-sectional operators
